description: ANCHORAGE, AK – U.S. Senator Dan Sullivan (R-Alaska) earned endorsements from Senator Lisa Murkowski and Congressman Nick Begich (both R-Alaska) for his 2026 re-election bid against Democrat Mary Peltola. Murkowski swiftly endorsed Sullivan on Monday, citing their work together in the Senate, despite previously backing Peltola in her previous House races.
